title: Lane lint gives a verdict inside the cloud's command time limit
why: `merge --lane-lint 1458` hit the 590 s command time limit twice in a cloud session with no verdict (lane notes-fix-large-1, 06:57 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: lane lint on #1458's head prints a verdict in a cloud session, or it runs in the background and a later call reads its verdict. Measure each step's time first. Watch step lane-lint-hook-suites (#1916), which adds suites. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Title by triage. Doing in lane session_013NEJL1PUcS4Dxhd9Rr1sk2 (07:02 CST Nov 8); it measures each lane-lint step's time on #1458's head first. Governing ruling: decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job, owner's words (2026-10-27, page item 27 a): a lane runs only the suites its change touches, and never a whole CI job. The sentence 'It runs no hook suite and no mutation test' landed later (batch 23, #840, 2026-10-29) as a tool description, not the owner's words; #1844, #1916 and #2001 rewrite it to 'picked suites only', which fits the ruling. So lane lint runs only the suites the change picks; the 52 lint fixture suites (513.6 s of 586.2 s on #1458's head, n=1, 4 CPUs) run only when picked. Page item 422 was withdrawn on that ruling (07:39 CST; reply corrected 07:43 CST Nov 8). Lane conflict answered from the ruling, nothing filed (07:43 CST Nov 8). Built as #2017, at review round 2 (lane, 09:12 CST Nov 8).
